Live product feel

Ask the document — get a grounded answer

Drop a PDF, ask in plain language, and receive a reply tied to the exact clause or page.

Acme_MSA_2024.pdf

From Acme_MSA_2024.pdf — what is the renewal notice period, and which section says so?

Either party may terminate for convenience with 60 days’ written notice before the renewal date. The term auto-renews for successive 12-month periods unless that notice is given.

Cited · §7.2 Term & Renewal · p. 11

Capabilities

Six primitives for document intelligence

Compose summarise, extract, and ask endpoints — or run them alone against your corpus.

Summarise

Condense multi-page PDFs into executive briefs with controllable length and tone.

Extract

Pull structured fields — dates, amounts, parties — into JSON ready for your pipeline.

Classify

Route contracts, invoices, and tickets with custom labels and confidence scores.

Translate

Preserve layout-aware meaning across 40+ languages without losing citations.

Search

Semantic retrieval over your corpus with filters for file type, date, and ACL.

Cite sources

Every answer links back to page spans so reviewers can verify in one click.

Developers

One POST. Cited JSON back.

Authenticate with a bearer key, send a document id and question, and receive an answer plus source spans. Streaming and webhooks are available on Growth and Scale.

SDKs for Python and Node mirror the REST surface — no new concepts to learn.

curl https://api.nimbus.ai/v1/ask \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $NIMBUS_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "document_id": "doc_8f3a",
    "question": "What is the renewal notice period?"
  }'
import requests

res = requests.post(
  "https://api.nimbus.ai/v1/ask",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"},
  json={
    "document_id": "doc_8f3a",
    "question": "What is the renewal notice period?",
  },
)
print(res.json()["answer"])
const res = await fetch("https://api.nimbus.ai/v1/ask", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.NIMBUS_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    document_id: "doc_8f3a",
    question: "What is the renewal notice period?",
  }),
});
const { answer } = await res.json();

Use cases

Customer support

Answer from the knowledge base

Connect product manuals and help articles so agents — and bots — reply with cited passages instead of guesswork.

Research teams

Upload whitepapers and transcripts; ask for themes, contradictions, and quotable excerpts with page references.

Legal & compliance

Ground answers in the clause

Query NDAs and policies with source spans. Reviewers jump straight to the paragraph that backs each claim.
